source: COMPOSED from @google/genai v2.27.0 FinishReason docs: MAX_TOKENS 'reached the configured maximum output tokens'; MALFORMED_FUNCTION_CALL 'The function call generated by the model is invalid.'; RECITATION (copyright); UNEXPECTED_TOOL_CALL (Agent Platform: 'semantically invalid'). These end a turn with no usable answer but are NOT safety blocks — they exist so the architect decides each explicitly (error vs empty result) instead of the provider returning an empty success by accident. Values invented.
